message.content: According to the conversation recorded on 20260905, Wolfgang Schulz expresses feelings of being overwhelmed and under a lot of pressure due to a new software project. Specifically, he mentions, "Just remember, this pressure won’t last forever. You’re super talented, and I believe in you! Just take it one step at a time." Wolfgang feels that the current pressure is temporary and believes in his capabilities, offering encouragement and advice to manage the workload effectively. LiHua, on the other hand, reassures Wolfgang by highlighting his talent and suggesting a break through jamming, which he finds enjoyable and a way to relieve stress.
